concept.hr: Ponestalo inodea; obrisana datoteka koju proces drži otvorenom
concept.en: Running out of inodes; a deleted file a process holds open

summary.hr: Napuni disk na dva načina: sitnim datotekama do zadnjeg inodea i zapisnikom koji je obrisan, a još otvoren. Pa df, df -i, du i lsof nađu uzrok.
summary.en: Fill a disk two ways: with tiny files up to the last inode, and with a log that is deleted but still open. Then df, df -i, du and lsof find the cause.

concept.hr: Datoteke od jednog bajta potroše sve inode prije blokova
concept.en: 1-byte files use up every inode before the blocks
